title: Add Dynamic Self-Healing Retry Loop in OrchestratorEngine
description: Enhance `OrchestratorEngine.run_fleet` in `core/orchestrator.py` to support dynamic retry loops. If a task fails quality gates, capture gate failure diagnostics (AST violations or test failures), format them into a prompt feedback message, and allow the agent worker up to 3 retry attempts before marking the task as failed/quarantined.
acceptance_criteria: Orchestrator retries failed tasks up to max_retries=3
Feed error tracebacks back into agent input payload

title: Implement Automated Worktree Garbage Collector
description: Add `cleanup_stale_worktrees(max_age_hours=24)` to `worktrees/manager.py` to prune orphaned `.worktrees/task-*` folders and delete merged git branches automatically.
acceptance_criteria: Prunes dangling worktrees older than threshold
Unit test verifies cleanup of dummy worktree directory

title: Add Universal TASKS.json Backlog Ingestion to CLI
description: Add a `python cli.py daemon --repo <path>` command that reads any target repository's `TASKS.json`, dispatches tasks through the fleet, and writes completion status back to the JSON file.
acceptance_criteria: CLI command accepts target repository path
Executes pending tasks in priority order
Updates task status to COMPLETED or QUARANTINED in TASKS.json
